Game Overview

Pixel Time Summer is a two-player title where join forces with a friend in Pixel Time Summer’s retro pixelated world. Master six vibrant levels filled with strategic challenges. Communicate effectively and time your moves perfectly to navigate obstacles using double jumps, ensuring your adventurous arcade experience is thrilling and fun. Cooperation paves the way to victory!
